# REVAKALP

> Revakalp is an Indian ethnic and contemporary clothing boutique founded in 2014 in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, offering curated regional handloom sarees, bridal lehengas, Indo-Western outfits, and everyday printed tees online and in-store.

## Brand & Boutique Facts
- Legal Trade Name: Revakalp (Founder: Anjali Katare)
- Location: 231-231, Shop No. 2, Dhanwantri Nagar, Rajendra Nagar, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452012, India
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:30 AM – 8:30 PM IST
- Contact: contact@revakalp.com | +91 91096-76562
- Fulfillment: Pan-India shipping (dispatched within 3–5 business days) and Indore retail store fulfillment

## Shop Collections
- [All Collections](https://revakalp.com/shop): Curated ethnic and contemporary edits available in store and online.
- [Sarees Overview](https://revakalp.com/shop/saree): Browse regional weaves including Maheshwari, Chanderi, Banarasi, Kanjivaram, Paithani, and Pashmina.
- [All Sarees Catalog](https://revakalp.com/shop/saree/all): Complete in-stock saree selection.
- [Lehengas](https://revakalp.com/shop/lehenga/all): Bridal and celebration lehengas.
- [Indo-Western](https://revakalp.com/shop/indo-western/all): Fusion silhouettes, drape skirts, and structured festive sets.
- [Printed Tees](https://revakalp.com/shop/printed-tees/all): Relaxed cotton graphic tees for everyday wear.

## Indian Textile Atlas (29 State Saree Dossiers)
- [29-State Heritage Atlas & 3D Weave Explorer](https://revakalp.com/heritage): Official Survey of India map paired with detailed state weaving histories and real-time 3D cloth drape studies.
- [Extended Catalog & Full 29-State Manifest](https://revakalp.com/llms-full.txt): Full markdown summary of all regional weave dossiers and store policies.

## Customer Care & Statutory Policies
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://revakalp.com/faq): Authenticity, weave specifics, delivery timelines, sizing, and COD availability.
- [Delivery & Shipping](https://revakalp.com/delivery-information): Dispatch SLAs, Indore store pickup/waivers, and live order tracking.
- [Returns & Exchanges](https://revakalp.com/returns-exchanges): 7-day return/exchange window for unworn garments with original tags and unboxing verification.
- [About Revakalp](https://revakalp.com/about): Store story since 2014 and handpicked quality inspection process.
- [Contact Us](https://revakalp.com/contact): Direct store address, WhatsApp/phone, and inquiry channel.
- [Grievance Redressal](https://revakalp.com/grievance-redressal): Statutory Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 grievance redressal desk.
